reviewStatus: authored construction illustration; mechanical review open

hosts.label: plate
hosts.evidence: Fixed construction reference; pressed plate jewels, Incabloc and banking pins retained.

hosts.label: train bridge
hosts.evidence: Parallel source locating pins and jewel bores seat into main plate; cap and chatons stay fitted.

hosts.label: regulator
hosts.evidence: Balance staff and bridge locating pins are axial. Balance, hairspring, collet, both source studs and bridge retained together to avoid tearing the spring anchorage.

hosts.label: barrel bridge
hosts.evidence: Two barrel jewel axes and locating pins are parallel to source Z. Bridge clears complete barrels before barrel lift.

hosts.label: center bridge
hosts.evidence: Center jewel and two locating pins share Z; train bridge clears first.

hosts.label: pallet bridge
hosts.evidence: Pallet jewel and locating pins share Z; retained pressed jewel and pins.

hosts.label: barrel left
hosts.evidence: Complete barrel drum/lid/arbor/mainspring retained; coaxial plate/bridge bearings. No spring or lid disassembly.

hosts.label: barrel right
hosts.evidence: Complete barrel drum/lid/arbor/mainspring retained; coaxial plate/bridge bearings. No spring or lid disassembly.

hosts.label: center wheel
hosts.evidence: Center riveted wheel/pinion/bearing and barrel transfer wheel retained as a coupled illustrative packet; axial bearings.

hosts.label: train wheels
hosts.evidence: Riveted wheel/pinion/hub packets retain their relative source relationship; coaxial plate and bridge journals.

hosts.label: pallet
hosts.evidence: Pallet staff axis and bearing seats are Z; jewels, horns and safety component stay with fork.

hosts.label: front cap
hosts.evidence: Cap plate and pressed endstone retained; screws enter from positive-Z face.

hosts.label: front display
hosts.evidence: Coaxial cannon/hour assemblies and riveted motion works retained as front display packet, including through arbor; preserves nested tubes.

hosts.label: ratchets
hosts.evidence: Ratchets withdraw toward positive-Z heads of their arbor screws; both complete barrels remain on the opposite side.

hosts.label: rear display
hosts.evidence: Rear motion-works bridge, pressed jewel/pins and nested wheel/arbor packet retained; clears barrel bridge before its lift. Screws seat in barrel bridge: host translation composes with that bridge exactly once.

hosts.label: shock
hosts.evidence: Complete shock module retained to preserve delicate return springs, forks, adjustment pins and reset linkage; base locating pins are axial.

hosts.label: winding bridge
hosts.evidence: Winding bridge with crown wheel/cap/click/spring retained as a unit; source locating pins are Z.

hosts.label: stem
hosts.evidence: Bare stem withdraws +world X through radius .7 plate passage; original BRep intersections remain zero at +1,+3,+6 mm. 8 mm clears the coupling-wheel outer face before the larger gears lift. Unknown service-release constraints are not simulated.

hosts.label: keyless
hosts.evidence: Riveted levers, setting springs and all pins retained as one illustrative keyless layer; +Z pivots. Alternate P66 remains hidden. Clear setting-lever finger from stem groove before the stem slides.

hosts.label: clamps
hosts.evidence: Three case mounting clamps follow their downward-facing screw heads; case is not displayed.

hosts.label: stem gears
hosts.evidence: Horizontal coupling wheel and clutch remain together, then lift through the open split-bearing side after stem extraction and winding bridge clearance. BRep common volume with plate is zero at -Z .25,.5,1,2,4 mm; +X packet route rejected for solid collisions.
